custom_logic_notes: Standard Ichimoku strategy with all five lines: Tenkan-sen (conversion), Kijun-sen (base), Senkou Span A (leading span A), Senkou Span B (leading span B), and Chinkou Span (lagging span). Entry requires Tenkan/Kijun crossover plus price position relative to Kumo cloud and Chinkou Span confirmation. SL/TP values use digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers). Signal on previous bar values (shift 1) to avoid repainting.
python_conversion_notes: Ichimoku indicator is available in ta-lib (ICHIMOKU function) and pandas-ta. Must replicate the five-component calculation: Tenkan-sen = (9-period high + 9-period low)/2, Kijun-sen = (26-period high + 26-period low)/2, Senkou Span A = (Tenkan + Kijun)/2 shifted 26 bars ahead, Senkou Span B = (52-period high + 52-period low)/2 shifted 26 bars ahead, Chinkou Span = close shifted 26 bars back. Entry signals use bar index [1] (previous completed bar) to prevent look-ahead bias. Digit adjustment logic for SL/TP must be replicated: if _Digits==5 or _Digits==3, multiply pip values by 10. New bar detection uses static datetime comparison.
